text:
jamie: Heads up — starting deploy of release v3.2.1 to canary (eu-west) in ~2m. Can folks watch SLO dashboards and call out any regressions? :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy started: release=v3.2.1 stage=canary region=eu-west user=jamie
maria: watching dashboards now. ping me if p95 or error rate nudges up. I have the canary panel open.
kevin: will keep an eye on 5xx and latency. If p95 > 250ms or 5xx spike > 0.5% for 2 windows, i suggest pausing and routing to previous version.
elena: noted. preflight smoke passed. rolling 10% traffic -> canary.
sre-bot: alert: embed-service 5xx_rate increased to 0.8% over 1m (threshold 0.5%) for eu-west-canary. source=prometheus rule=canary-5xx-sentinel
maria: seeing the same on dashboard, spike on embed-create endpoint. Not huge but trending. Any correlation with request size?
kevin: checking traces... looks like a small blob of payloads from a partner integration that hit a null path. temporary surge; canary pods show higher queue depth.
jamie: I'm going to pause the rollout to 0% traffic on canary and pin traffic back to v3.2.0 while we triage. deploy-bot, pause canary and pin route to v3.2.0.
deploy-bot: action: pause_rollout release=v3.2.1 stage=canary region=eu-west by=jamie — success
elena: rollback not required yet, we're pausing. Can we flip fallback to v3.2.0 for that route and keep canary instances up for logs?
kevin: yes, pinning route now: `rbacctl route set --route embed.create --version v3.2.0 --region eu-west`
sre-bot: info: routing change applied, newTraffic: 100% -> v3.2.0 for embed.create in eu-west
maria: good — error rate fell back to baseline ~0.12% after pin. I'm grabbing logs from the canary pods to surface the null path.
jamie: thanks. please file a short postmortem note in the release thread once we confirm root cause. For now let's keep v3.2.1 paused and do a small config tweak for payload validation before reattempt. :thumbsup:
elena: will open a ticket and attach logs. assigning to @kevin and @maria.
kevin: I'll add a transient null-check guard in a small patch and we can re-run canary at 5% for 10m with explicit synthetic traffic.
maria: +1 on synthetic traffic. also add a metric tag for partner_id so we can filter next time.
jamie: agreed. call it out in release notes too: "paused v3.2.1 canary due to transient embed-create 5xx spike; patch queued". Rolling follow-up in 30m.
deploy-bot: note: deploy paused. release=v3.2.1 status=paused reason=canary-5xx-sentinel user=jamie
kevin: quick checklist for re-run: 1) patch deployed to canary image 2) synthetic load 3) observe 10m with p95<250ms and 5xx<0.25% 4) progressive roll to 50% if green
maria: logged root-cause hypothesis in ticket #RELEASE-4421. attaching sample stacktrace.
jamie: thanks all — nice fast response. i'll update product and support that we held the change and are triaging.
elena: adding a brief entry in changelog draft so CS has context.
jamie: thread closed for now, reopen if anything changes.
sre-bot: reminder: add canary test to regression suite to catch this path.
